body:
Thank you all for attending today, we had quite a large group! Here are the notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9254):

### Agenda  
Attendees: Christopher Cameron, Anne van Kesteren, Olli Pettay, Vladimir Levin, Mason Freed, Brian Kardell, Shu-yu Guo, Emilio Cobos Álvarez, Joey Arhar, Panos Astithas, Robert Flack, Hannah Van Opstal, Kagami Rosylight, Simon Pieters, Khushal Sagar, Chris Harrelson, Chris Wilson

1. Review past action items
    1. Domenic to look into anchor element interactions for [Modernized version of window.open() API](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7485)
        1. [Done](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7485#issuecomment-1525056057).
    1. Emilio will help advise how to make the [CloseWatcher spec](https://wicg.github.io/close-watcher/) more rigorous, and Domenic will work on upstreaming it to HTML.
        1. Emilio hasn't gotten to this yet, carrying over.
1. Carryovers from last time (we largely skipped this section in favor of the new topics below, given the many new attendees specifically for this meeting)
    1. [Anne] [Accessibility Attribute Request](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9084)
        1. Didn't have time for this.
    1. [Anne] [HTML cross-document encoding inheritance with bogus Content-Type charset](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8789)
        1. Didn't have time for this.
    1. [Fergal] [BroadcastChannel + bfcache proposal](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/8972#issuecomment-1512292547)
        1. Didn't have time for this.
    1. [Brian] [Update the :dir / directionality to include shadow dom](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9166) (was [Tests for directionality and shadow DOM](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/29820))
        1. Didn't have time for this.
1. New topics
    1. [Anne] [Standardize rendering of PQ and HLG HDR image content](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9112)
        1. Anne will get WebKit feedback, Emilio tagged Mozilla folks for feedback.
    1. [Khushal] [Detect UA transitions on same-document navigations](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8782)
        1. Related: [https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/8747](https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/8747)
        1. Anne and Olli will provide feedback or find others to do so.
    1. [Shu] Question about new jobs for [Atomics.waitAsync integration](https://github.com/tc39/ecma262/pull/3049)
        1. Shu will send an HTML PR after the clarifications that were discussed.
    1. [Brian] [editorial: add custom element extensibility bullet](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9088) 🙂
        1. Just a heads up so that people could provide feedback.

### Action Items

1. @annevk will get WebKit feedback, @emilio tagged Mozilla folks for feedback on [Standardize rendering of PQ and HLG HDR image content](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9112).
1. @annevk and @smaug---- will provide feedback for [Detect UA transitions on same-document navigations](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8782) or find others to do so.
1. @syg will send an HTML PR after the clarifications that were discussed around [Atomics.waitAsync integration](https://github.com/tc39/ecma262/pull/3049).
